questions.question: When the judge is offline and a SCHEDULED JOB hits a classifier ask, decision 0157 already routes it to a card in the job's conversation. Should that conversation also get the one-line outage notice before the card, like a DM does?
options: Yes, same one notice per conversation (Recommended)
No notice for jobs, reason line only
questions.chosen: Yes, same one notice per conversation (Recommended)

questions.question: The grill folded five fixes into T6; scope is now 13 files with a 15-file / 1,400-line review budget (over the 15-file target only on the budget headroom). Accept that budget, or split T6 into two tasks?
options: Split into T6a (latch, hooks, unit suites) and T6b (invariance suite, S6, aggregation)
